title: A Hippocrates Perspective on COVID-19
excerpt: As wellness advocates who have worked to strengthen the immunity of hundreds of thousands of guests over our 60+ years, we receive the open ears from those who are now willing to consider the message of what a strong immune system can do for the protection from preventable diseases.
content:
“In the midst of worries about the global coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak, it can be easy to slip into fears about the unknown and concerns about the suffering a global health crisis could cause. In fact, at times, it seems that fear surrounds us, fueled by the media and fed by our natural desires to protect our family and communities.”*

However, at Hippocrates we consider this a time of hope. As wellness advocates who have worked to strengthen the immunity of hundreds of thousands of guests over our 60+ years, we receive the open ears from those who are now willing to consider the message of what a strong immune system can do for the protection from preventable diseases.

“In fact, this is the ideal time to encourage family, friends and colleagues to focus on building a strong immune system through exercise, healthy nutrition, stress reduction, smoking cessation”, and all practices that are standard here at Hippocrates Wellness, “HHI”.

These are some of HHI’s recommended immune system boosting supplements:

  • LifeGive Phyto Vitamin C
  • LifeGive Vitamin D
  • Argentyne 23 (advanced bio-active silver)
  • Host Defense, (mushroom concentrate)
  • LifeGive CBD (hemp powder)
  • Natural Defense I.V. from our Liquivida partner

Additionally, we teach and encourage everyone as daily practice to stay clean and take daily saunas, which are the most effect way of rapidly fighting microbes.

Regarding incoming Hippocrates, program guests please be aware that we are doing our due diligence to pre-screen and qualify potential guests for any on-campus reservations. We have implemented temperature monitoring of incoming guests with additional protocols that adhere to CDC guidelines.
